Why does one cancer drug list at nearly $16,000 a month?
Ibrance's 2024 list price was $15,741 for 30 days; Medicare's negotiated 2027 price is $7,871.
Global cancer drug spending hit $252B in 2024, up from $164B in 2020 (IQVIA).
R&D estimates range from $985M to $2.8B per drug, and only 5.3% of cancer drug candidates reach approval from Phase I.
RAND: US brand-name prices were at least 3.22x, after rebates, other countries' in 2022. Part D out-of-pocket cap: $2,400 in 2027.
Sources: IQVIA, CMS, JAMA 2020, Tufts CSDD, BIO, RAND.
News and education, not financial advice.
